# MusicReady

A mod that adds some of the soundtracks released by MatyysMusic. You can listen to them in the 
[MusicReady Playlist.](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLDMojLwVvdCPD3WF4VCHcpoeSDC_W2NCU&si=2A1YeQMCFd4_9tc-)
### Works with NeoForge 1.21.4 only
